asked.item: Why the blog image shows instead of my attached photo
How to keep my own cake photo on the Facebook Page post

verdict.reason: The help page explains that a link in a Facebook post makes Facebook show the linked page's image, and gives steps to remove the link so the attached image is kept.

steps.text: When a Facebook post contains a link, Facebook creates a link preview and uses the linked page's featured image.
Facebook shows that image instead of the image you attached.
This behavior comes from Facebook, not Blotato.
To keep your own image, remove the link from the post: open the post in Content Studio > Post editor and delete the link from the post text.
If you still want to share the URL, paste it as plain text in the caption instead of as a preview link, then confirm your attached image is the one you want and schedule or publish the post.
